title: Google DeepMind expands game partnerships to test general AI agents
friendlyTitle: DeepMind is testing smarter AI agents inside games
summary: Google DeepMind is working with studios including Fenris Creations, Hello Games, and Coffee Stain to prototype AI-driven gameplay and develop agents that can understand varied 3D worlds through ordinary screen, keyboard, and mouse interfaces.
friendlySummary: Google DeepMind is working with game studios to build agents that can see, understand, and act in many different game worlds.
whyItMatters: Games offer controlled but demanding environments for testing adaptive companions, automated quality assurance, and agents that may later transfer their planning skills to real-world software and robotics.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could improve game characters and testing tools, while helping researchers build agents that handle changing situations.
